messages:
maria: just merged patch for CVE-2026-1427 affecting http-parser-lite. kicking canary 1% now. need quick smoke + perf SLI delta checks. watching KMS calls and audit logs. any objections?

sam: ack. i'll run the app smoke suite against canary.

deploy-bot: Started rollout of release r-2026.1427 to pool canary-1 (1% traffic)

oliver: make sure RBAC token refresh flow tested; last patch changed header handling.

anya: added smoke checklist in thread: 
```
- curl -v https://api.redwood.example/health
- run e2e: tests/smoke/auth_kms.test --env canary
- check audit logs: /dash/audit?service=http-layer
``` 

sam: running now. ETA ~7m

eng-sre: alert: small but reproducible p95 increase +20% on canary. details: https://dash/metrics?range=1h :eyes: 

maria: noted. pause rollout, revert if errors >0.5% 5xx or p95 delta >15% per SLI policy.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by maria. Current traffic remains 1%.

anya: I'm tailing KMS traffic; no auth failures. audit lines show additional metadata fields — might be extra header processing latency. filing a quick PR to strip X-Internal when calling KMS.

oliver: will run a micro-bench on RPC path. can someone attach the flamegraph link when ready?

sam: smoke passed but integration latency shows +30ms median on canary. attaching logs: 
```
http-layer | call_kms 2026-06-15T14:12:33Z duration=95ms
http-layer | call_kms 2026-06-15T14:12:40Z duration=120ms
```

maria: action items: (1) oliver to bench and open perf PR (2) anya to submit header-strip PR + canary config tweak (3) sam to re-run smoke after PR. keep rollback on deck. ping me on thread when verified.

eng-sre: tagged incident-ops in case we need rollback. :thumbsup: 

maria: thanks team. will update after repro/patch. everyone keep channels open.
